questions.question: As on 31st October 2023, the youngest member of parliament (in terms of age) in the 17th Lok Sabha, Chandrani Murmu, represents which political party?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Biju Janata Dal**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Chandrani Murmu is the youngest Member of Parliament (MP) in the 17th Lok Sabha, elected at the age of 25.
 
• She represents the **Biju Janata Dal (BJD)**, a regional political party based in Odisha.
 
• She was elected from the **Keonjhar constituency** in Odisha during the 2019 general elections.
 
• Chandrani Murmu is the first woman MP from Keonjhar and one of the youngest MPs in India’s parliamentary history.
 
• Her election highlighted the growing representation of young leaders in Indian politics.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Biju Janata Dal (BJD):**

 
 
• BJD is a regional political party in Odisha, founded in 1997 by Naveen Patnaik.
 
• The party is named after Naveen Patnaik's father, Biju Patnaik, a prominent freedom fighter and former Chief Minister of Odisha.
 
• BJD has a strong presence in Odisha and focuses on regional development and welfare policies.
 
 
 
• **17th Lok Sabha:**
 
 
• The 17th Lok Sabha was constituted following the 2019 general elections in India.
 
• It marked a significant rise in the number of women MPs, with 78 women elected, the highest in Indian history.
 
 
 
• **Women in Indian Politics:**
 
 
• India has seen a gradual increase in women’s participation in politics, though gender representation remains uneven.
 
• Efforts like reservation for women in local governance (Panchayati Raj) have paved the way for greater involvement.
 
 
 
• **Odisha in Indian Politics:**
 
 
• Odisha has played a significant role in Indian politics, with leaders like Biju Patnaik and Naveen Patnaik shaping its political landscape.
 
• The state is known for its unique socio-political challenges, including tribal welfare and disaster management.

questions.question: A party recognised by the Election Commission of India that secures at least ________ of the total votes in the General Election to Lok Sabha or Legislative Assembly in four or more states in addition to winning four Lok Sabha seats is called a National Party.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**six per cent**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• A party is recognized as a National Party by the Election Commission of India if it secures at least **six per cent of the total votes** in the General Election to Lok Sabha or Legislative Assembly in four or more states.
 
• In addition to the vote percentage, the party must also win at least **four Lok Sabha seats**.
 
• Recognition as a National Party provides the party with several privileges, including a common symbol for candidates across India.
 
• National parties have the ability to influence national politics and policies due to their significant presence across multiple states.
 
• As of the latest information, India has eight recognized National Parties.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **State Party Recognition:**

 
 
• To be recognized as a State Party, a party must secure at least six per cent of the total votes in the Legislative Assembly or Lok Sabha elections in that state.
 
• It must also win at least two seats in the Legislative Assembly of the state.
 
 
 
• **Symbol Allocation:**
 
 
• National and State Parties are granted exclusive symbols for their candidates.
 
• Independent candidates and unrecognized parties can choose from a list of free symbols.
 
 
 
• **Election Commission of India (ECI):**
 
 
• The ECI is an autonomous constitutional authority responsible for administering election processes in India.
 
• It ensures free and fair elections to the Parliament, State Legislatures, and the offices of the President and Vice President.
 
 
 
• **Privileges of National Parties:**
 
 
• National Parties are entitled to broadcast/telecast facilities during elections on public broadcasters Doordarshan and All India Radio.
 
• They are also allowed to consult with the ECI regarding the dates of elections and other important electoral matters.

questions.question: An alliance formed by political parties after elections when no party has been able to get adequate seats to form a clear majority is called ______.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**coalition**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• A coalition government is a type of government where two or more political parties join together in parliament/ assembly to run the government and agree on a policy program.

 
 
• A coalition government is a cabinet of a parliamentary government in which several parties cooperate.
 
• The usual reason given for this arrangement is that no party on its own can achieve a majority in the parliament.
 
• A coalition government might also be created in a time of national difficulty or crisis, for example during wartime, to give a government the high degree of perceived political legitimacy it desires and also playing a role in diminishing internal political strife.
 
• In such times, parties have formed all-party coalitions (national unity governments, grand coalitions).
 
• If a coalition collapses a confidence vote is held or a motion of no confidence is taken.
 
• A coalition government is oftentimes considered a very weak form of government because there is no majority party.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Appropriation**

 
 
• Appropriation Bill gives power to the government to withdraw funds from the Consolidated Fund of India for meeting the expenditure during the financial year.
 
• It is introduced by Finance Minister.
 
• It is introduced in Lok Sabha.
 
• It gives the legal power to the Govt. for expenditure.
 
 
 
• **prorogation**
 
 
• Prorogation is the action of discontinuing a session of the House without dissolving it.
 
• Once the Business of the Session is completed, The Presiding officer declares the House adjourned sine die, Then within a few days, the President issues a notification for Prorogation of the Session.
 
• The President can Prorogue the House while it is in session.
 
• It terminates both, the sitting of the house and the session of the house.​

questions.question: Which of the following ministries has launched the National Career Service Portal (www.ncs.gov.in) ?

options.text: Ministry of Personnel, Public Grievances and Pensions
Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports

questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Ministry of Labour and Employment**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The National Career Service Portal (**www.ncs.gov.in**) was launched by the **Ministry of Labour and Employment** in **July 2015** to connect job seekers with employers.
 
• It is a one-stop platform aimed at providing **employment-related services**, including job postings, career counseling, skill training, and placement assistance.
 
• The portal offers services to **students, job seekers, employers, skill providers, career counselors**, and placement organizations.
 
• The initiative is part of the government's mission to provide **transparent, efficient, and accessible employment services** to the citizens of India.
 
• The NCS Portal is integrated with **Aadhaar** for verification purposes and facilitates real-time job matching based on user profiles.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **National Career Service (NCS)**

 
 
• It was launched under the **National Career Service Project**, which is an initiative of the Ministry of Labour and Employment.
 
• The project aims to modernize the existing **National Employment Service** by leveraging technology to provide efficient and user-friendly services.
 
• The portal provides **free registration and services** for all Indian citizens, ensuring inclusivity and accessibility.
 
• The service also facilitates **career guidance and counseling** through a network of Model Career Centers (MCCs) across the country.
 
 
 
• **Employment Exchanges**
 
 
• Before the NCS Portal, employment exchanges were the primary mechanism for job matching in India.
 
• These exchanges operated manually, which resulted in inefficiencies and limited outreach.
 
• The NCS Portal modernized this approach by digitizing job-matching services and providing real-time data accessibility.
 
 
 
• **Government Initiatives for Employment Generation**
 
 
• **Skill India Mission:** Focuses on providing skill training to the youth to enhance employability.
 
• **Make in India:** Aims to boost manufacturing and create job opportunities in India.
 
• **Startup India:** Promotes entrepreneurship and supports startups with financial and regulatory assistance.
 
• **PM Kaushal Vikas Yojana:** Provides free skill training to increase employment opportunities.
 
 
 
• **Aadhaar Integration**
 
 
• Aadhaar integration ensures **identity verification** and prevents duplication of job seeker profiles.
 
• It enhances the credibility and transparency of the services provided by the portal.

questions.question: Which department of the Government of India declares the minimum support prices?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Department of Agriculture and Cooperation**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The Department of Agriculture and Co-operation, **Government of India, declares Minimum Support Prices (MSP) for 23 crops before their sowing seasons, based on the recommendations of the **Commission for Agricultural Costs and Prices.**
 
• It recommends MSPs of 23 commodities, are following:
 
 
• 7 oilseeds including groundnut, rapeseed-mustard, soybean, sesamum, sunflower, safflower, and nigerseed.
 
• 7 kinds of cereal including paddy, wheat, maize, sorghum, pearl millet, barley, and ragi.
 
• 5 pulses including gram, tur, moong, urad, and lentil.
 
• 4 commercial crops include copra, sugarcane, cotton, and raw jute.
 
 
 
• Despite the COVID-19 pandemic, the Government of India's policies and decisions on farmers' welfare have resulted in minor improvements in food grain production and maintained agriculture growth.
 
• **The Cabinet Committee on Economic Affairs (CCEA)**, chaired by** Hon'ble Prime Minister Narendra Modi,** has approved an increase in the Minimum Support Prices (MSP) for all specified Rabi crops for the **Rabi Marketing Season (RMS) 2022-23** on September 8, 2021, when the sowing season is in advance.​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **The Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare, **formerly the Ministry of Agriculture, is a division of the Indian government that is responsible for the design and implementation of agricultural rules and regulations.
 
• **The Department of Investment and Public Asset Management (DIPAM) **oversees all aspects of the Central Government's equity investments, including disinvestment in Central Public Sector Undertakings.
 
• **The Department of Economic Affairs** is the Union Government's nodal department for formulating and monitoring the country's economic policies and programmes that affect domestic and international economic management.
 
• **The Ministry of Finance** oversees the Department of Expenditure.

__
 
• The reserved symbol of the **All India Trinamool Congress (AITC)** is not a sickle but **Flowers and Grass**.
 
• The **symbol** of Flowers and Grass represents the party's commitment to its grassroots approach and policies.
 
• Founded by **Mamata Banerjee** in 1998, the AITC is primarily active in the state of **West Bengal**.

questions.question: Which of the following country’s official language is Sinhala?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Sri Lanka**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Sinhala** is one of the two official languages of Sri Lanka, alongside Tamil, as per the Sri Lankan constitution.
 
• Sinhala belongs to the **Indo-Aryan language family**, which is a branch of the Indo-European languages.
 
• Around **16 million people in Sri Lanka** speak Sinhala as their first language, making it the majority language of the country.
 
• The Sinhala script, which is unique, is used for writing Sinhala and has been derived from the ancient Brahmi script.
 
• Sri Lanka is a multi-ethnic and multilingual country, but Sinhala is predominantly spoken by the Sinhalese ethnic group, who make up about **75% of the population**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Sinhala Language Origins:**

 
 
• Sinhala evolved from the ancient Indo-Aryan languages introduced to Sri Lanka by migrants from the Indian subcontinent.
 
• It has been influenced by Pali, Sanskrit, and Dravidian languages, especially Tamil.
 
 
 
• **Official Language Policy of Sri Lanka:**
 
 
• The Official Languages Act of 1956 made Sinhala the sole official language, which was later amended to include Tamil in 1987.
 
• English is widely used as a **link language** in government and education.
 
 
 
• **Sinhala Literature:**
 
 
• Sinhala has a rich literary tradition dating back to at least the 9th century CE.
 
• Ancient texts like the **Mahavamsa**, a historical chronicle, were written in Pali but heavily influenced Sinhala literature.
 
 
 
• **Sinhalese Ethnic Group:**
 
 
• The Sinhalese are the largest ethnic group in Sri Lanka, primarily practicing Buddhism.
 
• Their culture, festivals, and traditions are closely tied to the Sinhala language and Buddhist practices.
